description: This file contains the implementation of a RecyclerView Adapter named ProductAdapter for displaying a list of Product items in an Android application. It manages product data, calculates diffs for efficient UI updates, and binds product information to views. It also interacts with a ShopRepository to fetch category information for display.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for binding Product data to RecyclerView items, handling diffing for updates, and managing item clicks.

classes.name: ProductAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder inner class for holding item views and binding Product data to UI components.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of products and a repository, using DiffUtil to efficiently animate changes.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable item ID based on the product's hash code to help RecyclerView optimize item animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Product item to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds product data to view elements and sets an OnClickListener.
